units.source_text: 信子抬了抬眼睑，反问说：“你真的这么觉得？”

en.t: Nobuko raised her eyelids slightly and asked in reply, "Do you really think so?"

units.source_text: 这话刚出来她就懊悔了。

en.t: No sooner had the words left her mouth than she regretted them.

units.source_text: 有那么一刹那，照子的脸色有点奇怪，她看着姐姐的眼睛，也露出后悔的表情。

en.t: For an instant, Teruko's expression looked a little strange; as she looked into her sister's eyes, she too showed a look of regret.
